articles.title: U.S. senators lament failure to win bipartisan support, yet, on crypto Clarity Act
articles.snippet: In the hearing to advance the market structure bill to its next stage, lawmakers from both parties granted lengthy talks hadn't yet found needed common ground.

articles.title: BlackRock, Janus Henderson tokenized funds get instant redemptions with new $1 billion facility
articles.snippet: A new credit facility by Grove aims to allow instant redemptions into stablecoins from BlackRock's BUIDL and Janus Henderson's money market funds, reducing settlement time from days to instantaneous.

articles.title: Moody’s assigns Aaa-mf assessments to Fidelity International and BlackRock tokenized money market funds
articles.snippet: The assessment suggest the highest level of credit quality, liquidity and capital preservation.

articles.title: Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong gets behind CLARITY Act ahead of Thursday markup
articles.snippet: Armstrong said the bill is "closer than ever" to advancing in the US Congress after months of negotiations between the crypto industry and banks.

articles.title: Kraken to Migrate Wrapped Bitcoin Tech to Chainlink as LayerZero Exodus Expands
articles.snippet: Crypto exchange Kraken is the latest firm to shift away from LayerZero tech following last month's $292 million Kelp DAO exploit.
